high: All available reference-code multisets match exactly, including multiplicities; pinned sources match.
Every measured hot phase has 64 hits and zero leaders; a direct reference encoder GPU speedup cannot explain hot contrasts.
limited: Cold B throughput gains accompany shorter observed service latency but are not isolated from generation length, scheduling or instrumentation.

No statistically supported full hot-performance causal effect is established by these six visits.

strategy.admission: Fair FIFO; eight callers and fixed eight outstanding waveforms, not a queue-depth optimization.
strategy.timing_scope: Host-to-CPU-code diagnostic includes CPU resampling, admission, H2D, encode, D2H, synchronization, hashing and diagnostic bookkeeping/serialization; phase wall excludes explicit final JSON save; not GPU-only or full file decode.
strategy.excluded_timing: All old strategy timings INVALID for ranking: original0 CPU overlap and non-FIFO severe starvation. Original0 codes retained only as correctness baseline.
qualifications: Fair timings are host-to-CPU-code diagnostic timings, not GPU-only kernel timings: they include CPU resampling, FIFO queueing, H2D, encode, D2H, synchronization, hashing and phase bookkeeping. Error-free phase wall excludes the explicit end-of-phase JSON save; any diagnostic serialization must not be represented as GPU compute.

Higher-n exclusive jobs reserve all permits but choose an available worker stream; they do not pin long work to production's stable long_stream. These boundaries are diagnostic n3/n4 capacity and parity checks, not validation of production stable-long-stream placement.

Higher-n allocator retries cannot be attributed intrinsically to stream count because placement differs from production. Previously validated production n2 stable-stream memory evidence remains separate.
Fair n1 exceeds n2 in pooled hot throughput and has lower p95 in both passes; n2 is not demonstrated best. No clean original0 timing or bundle factorization proof was added.
Read-only review confirmed batch gate interpretation. No additional run, GPU operation or production edit followed this qualification.
limitations: Only two hot passes with material repeat variation; no proven unique optimal n.

Boundary is public-waveform loop/crop, not real128; memory history only final counters, not per-transition leakage proof.
